globalRateLimit.title: Global Rate Limit Default
globalRateLimit.subtitle: Request rate limiting applied by default to all proxy hosts. Each host can inherit, override, or disable it.
globalRateLimit.enableDescription: When enabled, this default applies to every host set to inherit.
globalRateLimit.infoTitle: How the Global Rate Limit Default Works
globalRateLimit.infoDesc: This default applies to all proxy hosts that leave the rate limit set to "Inherit". Each host keeps its own nginx limit_req zone — only the values are inherited. A host set to "Override" uses its own configuration, and one set to "Disable" gets no rate limit at all. Saving regenerates all inheriting hosts automatically.
globalRateLimit.saveSuccess: Global rate limit default saved and applied to inheriting hosts
globalRateLimit.saveFailed: Failed to save global rate limit default

globalWAF.title: Global WAF Default
globalWAF.subtitle: WAF (ModSecurity) mode, paranoia level and anomaly threshold applied by default to all proxy hosts. Each host can inherit, override, or disable it.
globalWAF.restartNote: WAF/ModSecurity rule changes are not picked up by a reload. Inheriting hosts' config files are regenerated immediately, but the change only takes effect after a proxy container restart (docker restart npg-proxy).
globalWAF.enableDescription: When enabled, this default applies to every host set to inherit.
globalWAF.infoTitle: How the Global WAF Default Works
globalWAF.infoDesc: This default applies to all proxy hosts that leave WAF set to "Inherit" (they use the global enabled flag plus its mode/paranoia/threshold). A host set to "Override" uses its own configuration, and one set to "Disable" turns WAF off regardless of the global default. Saving regenerates all inheriting hosts automatically.
globalWAF.saveSuccess: Global WAF default saved and applied to inheriting hosts (effective after restart)
globalWAF.saveFailed: Failed to save global WAF default
